response.title: Fix my n8n workflow: Google Sheets node fails on large batches
response.description: Our n8n workflow imports a CSV of about 5,000 rows each night and appends them to a Google Sheet. It worked for months, but now the Google Sheets node fails partway with "429 Too Many Requests" and we end up with half the rows. We need someone to fix it so the full file lands every night, with retries and a Slack message if it still fails.
